We've been going to Bensonhurst Vet Care since they first opened.  We've brought our fur babies,  and our colony cats and rescues here. Dr. Zawie and Dr. Pordfino always took excellent care of all of them.  When my then Senior Bello had multiple,  what seemed unrelated symptoms,  Dr. Zawie tirelessly worked to figure it out.  He also worked with us financially when we brought several rescues kittens with FIV who had to be euthanized. On all occasions the Dr's and staff called regularly to check up on our cats. Dr. Zamora has also seen several of our fur babies,  and had followed in the compassionate care of Dr. Zawie.  The Drs and staff are always empathetic,  caring and helpful.  I wouldn't consider doing anywhere else for our fur babies

UPDATE: The owner’s response contains inaccurate information. This appointment was not made “the night before.” It was scheduled approximately two weeks in advance, which I have now attached screenshots confirming.

The voicemail I received did not mention a late fee. It stated that my appointment would be CANCELLED after a 5 minute grace period, which was directly shared with the manager privately.

At this point, I believe the tone of the owner’s public response and the back and forth defensiveness speaks for itself, and only reinforces my original concerns regarding professionalism and bedside manner.

ORIGINAL: This was the last straw for me. Every visit recently has felt rushed and rude, but today’s experience crossed the line.

I communicated multiple times that I was actively on my way to my dog’s 10:30 appointment and arriving from Staten Island. Despite that, I received repeated calls while driving threatening cancellation of the appointment (10:37am). The employee, who identified herself as “Taylor” on voicemail and “Sabrina” in person, stated their grace period was only 5 minutes before cancelling the appointment.

I then had to call back again while parking to reassure them I was there and walking over.

When I arrived, the office was empty aside from one client finishing payment, yet the first thing I was told was that I would be charged a late fee. Multiple staff members then argued with me simultaneously instead of attempting to calmly handle the situation professionally.

By the time I walked in, I was visibly shaking from the stress, and even my dog became unusually stressed and had an elevated temperature during the visit.

Policies are one thing. Professionalism, compassion, and common sense are another. I will not be returning.

A huge thank you to Lenni for going above and beyond — you made both me and Diesel feel so comfortable and at ease. It’s not always easy bringing your pet in, but your patience, compassion, and attention to detail truly made all the difference.

Diesel was treated like family, and that means everything to me. I’m so grateful for the outstanding service and support. Highly recommend — definitely a 5-star experience!
Thank you.

To avoid a similar experience, I strongly advise against making the same mistake I made. I brought my dog here for a necessary spay, but the communication was severely lacking. Aside from feeling physically assaulted, I was waiting for blood results and never received the call despite being informed that I would receive them the next day. Three days later, I had to contact them, only to be informed that they were unable to perform the surgery there and that I would need to visit another facility. I waited for the manager to contact me, but this never occurred. Fortunately, I ended up at Four Legged Friends, where I encountered an exceptional veterinarian. I strongly recommend avoiding the same mistake I made.
